text:
maria: quick q — SOC asked for a one-off raw log snapshot of auth and proxy logs for a vuln triage. they want 30d of events but only need raw for 72h. thinking: timeboxed snapshot (72h), ephemeral KMS unwrap via kms-proxy, and a scoped RBAC role that expires. thoughts?

chris: +1 on timebox. we should avoid granting raw export more than necessary. how will the unwrap be audited?

maria: audit-bot should record unwrap + requester + ticket. proposal: policy requires a ticket id and approval from oncall or sec lead, and unwrap happens through `kms-proxy` which logs every UnwrapKey call.

aj: oncall here — ok with the flow but need guardrails: 1) snapshot TTL 72h, 2) explicit retention cut (we delete raw after snapshot TTL), 3) read-only copy stored in temp bucket with CMK envelope.

lucy: product question — will this be a manual run or API-triggered by an internal tool? need to know to update playbook.

maria: plan is manual request via svc ticket -> sec approves -> infra runs the export script which calls kms-proxy unwrap while passing `ticket_id` and `expiry` metadata. we want minimal automation for now.

chris: can you paste the minimal request template + the export CLI snippet? makes reviews faster.

maria: sure — template below. please comment if fields missing.

maria: ```
Request: 
- ticket_id: SEC-1234
- requester: alice@redwood.com
- justification: vulnerability triage for CVE-2026-xxxx
- time_window: 2026-03-20T00:00Z/2026-03-23T00:00Z
- retention_ttl_hours: 72
- approval: sec_lead or oncall

Export CLI (infra-run):
redwood-export --dataset auth,proxy --from 2026-03-20T00:00Z --to 2026-03-23T00:00Z \\n  --output s3://temp-sec-snapshots/SEC-1234/ --encrypt-with-cmk arn:aws:kms:...:key/xxxx \\n  --kms-proxy-unwrap-metadata \"ticket=SEC-1234;caller=maria;expiry=2026-03-26T00:00Z\"
```

aj: nice. make sure the temp bucket has lifecycle rule to delete after 7 days in case something fails deleting the object. also require MFA for any IAM principal that can call `redwood-export` in prod.

chris: for RBAC change, suggest a new `siem_snapshot_requester` role that: 1) can create snapshot tickets (no raw read), 2) can approve only when delegated, 3) cannot list CMK keys. actual unwrap permission only to `kms-proxy` service principal.

maria: exactly. unwrap IAM policy should be attached to `kms-proxy` (service account) only, with condition `kms:RequestTag/ticket = \"SEC-1234\"` style check. humans never get direct Decrypt.

lucy: update playbook items: who to notify, checklist to verify scrubbed PII if applicable, and a rollback path if export reveals more sensitive data.

maria: added. also want to surface this in the console: per-snapshot audit link and the approval chain.

audit-bot: ticket SEC-1234 created by alice@redwood.com (maria forwarded). recorded in audit log id: a0f5c3.approval=oncall.

chris: one last ask — add a post-export assertion that runs a scrubber/checker and emits a signed attest token before we hand data to requesters. means even if someone accidentally exports PII we have an automated hold.

maria: yep — will add `post_export_assertion: scrub_result=PASSED|FAILED` to the process and block access if FAILED.

aj: sounds good. i'll open the RBAC change PR and the infra runbook. tagging @maria for final review then i'll merge. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will review PR and put a short runbook in the security ops runbook folder.

chris: approved in principle. please link PR and runbook here when done.

maria: will do. closing for now unless someone objects. :lock:
